title: Vision-bridge visual defect record
description: A finding from visual review of a capture contact sheet. A defect is only ever closed by being reduced to a numeric check that a regression test can assert (the round-trip rule, see scripts/vision/README.md). 'Open' status is the honest default: no model's or reviewer's self-report counts as proof.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. V-0001. Never reused for a different finding.

source.description: Where the finding came from: contact sheet file name, shot name, or reviewer label.

image.description: Path to the PNG capture the finding refers to, relative to the repo root (e.g. evidence/phase2/times_square.png).

captured_at.description: Capture date/time of the image being reviewed (ISO 8601).

severity.description: critical: breaks the shot (dead frame, inside a wall). major: visibly wrong. minor: cosmetic.

description.description: Narrow, falsifiable statement of what is wrong, e.g. 'horizontal black band across the top quarter of the frame', never 'looks bad'.

check.description: The suggested numeric reduction of this finding. Reference to a framecheck-style measurable: a function exported by apps/manhattan-threejs/src/framecheck.js (built in parallel by the qa-integrity worker). The generated regression test calls check.fn(...check.args) and asserts the result against check.threshold with check.operator. A defect with status 'confirmed' but no check cannot be closed; it stays 'open'.

fn.description: Name of the exported check function in framecheck.js, e.g. luminanceStddev, distinctColours, occlusionFraction, pixelDiff.

args.description: Arguments passed to the function verbatim. The strings '$IMAGE' and '$IMAGE_DIR' are replaced at generation time by the absolute path of this defect's image and its directory.

operator.description: lt/lte/gt/gte: numeric comparison of the result against threshold. eq/neq: strict equality. approx: |result - threshold| <= threshold * 0.05 (relative tolerance).

unit.description: Unit of the measurement, e.g. 'luminance stddev (linear)', 'fraction of frame', 'count of pixels'.

ref.description: Pointer to the framecheck-style measurable this is based on (HANDOFF section, bug ledger id, or framecheck doc).

status.description: open: reported, not yet reduced to a numeric check. confirmed: a numeric check exists and has been seen to fail. rejected: checked numerically and shown to be a false positive. Only confirmed defects are converted to regression tests.

confirmed_by.description: Who/what confirmed: reviewer name, vision model id, or a numeric run. Required when status is 'confirmed'.

notes.description: Anything that changes the reading of the finding, e.g. known intermittent conditions.
